source.title: RHeaDHy Introduction to test matrix (Public)
source.reason_source_file_not_committed: The repository retains the persistent public DOI and cryptographic digest rather than redistributing the source PDF.

verified_public_plan.tank_system: FORVIA Truck Storage Test System representative of an approximately 100 kg heavy-duty vehicle storage system
project_kpis: hold -30 degC precooling throughout a 10 minute fill

high_priority_trace_families.purpose: SAE J2601-5 fills spanning initial pressure, ambient temperature, precooling target, flow class, back-to-back and soak conditions
PRR taper, K0 and volume-measurement options

verified_public_plan.public_release_commitment: The source states that selected test-campaign datasets and a summary report will be made publicly available.

known_before_freeze.known_aggregate_summary: 18 Mid Flow Twin tests over six days; public ranges and >95% SOC claim are already visible.
known_before_freeze.interpretation: This is a trace-level pre-access protocol, not a fully outcome-blind campaign protocol. Aggregate campaign success was public before the freeze.

frozen_evaluation.case_selection: Retain every released priority-1 RHeaDHy event with a test identifier and all required channel families; do not choose cases by prediction error.
required_channel_families: active bank and cascade valve or controller state
engineering units, calibration and quality metadata
integrity_rules: Verify publisher checksum and preserve the exact received files before parsing.
Reject rather than infer missing engineering units or channel identities.
Run the frozen model without case-specific parameter fitting.
Report every eligible case, failed case and unevaluable case.
Do not promote aggregate press-release outcomes to synchronized validation rows.
disqualifiers: fewer than eight disjoint evaluable traces
no vehicle or TSTS pressure and temperature
no station bank or controller state
no written right to publish derived validation metrics

next_action: Recheck the official RHeaDHy page and Zenodo query for the promised selected datasets; if released, hash-lock the files and execute this protocol without changing the screens.
claim_boundary: This artifact freezes a reproducible trace-level evaluation before synchronized rows are available. It is protocol-integrity evidence only. It neither converts the public test matrix or aggregate campaign report into validation data nor closes the full-loop, safety or journal-readiness gates.
